plainTranslation:
This person may bring out your confidence and remind you of what you are capable of achieving.

They often have a way of noticing what you are capable of, especially in moments when you have lost sight of it yourself. Their confidence in you can make it easier to trust your own direction, and being around them may leave you feeling more willing to reach for something larger than what you thought was available to you.

When this works well, being around this person can make it easier to trust your own growth. They have a way of reflecting back your strengths when you lose sight of them and reminding you that the future is still being written. Their belief in what is possible for you can help you reconnect with possibilities you had quietly set aside.

One of the greatest gifts of this connection is perspective. When self-doubt creeps in, they may remind you of how far you have come, what you have already accomplished, and what resources you have available to move forward.

The challenge is making sure encouragement is paired with accountability. Big dreams still require planning, consistency, and follow-through. It can be easy to focus on potential while overlooking the habits, skills, and effort needed to turn that potential into results.

Use their belief in you as fuel, not as a substitute for action. The most successful expression of this connection happens when optimism is matched with commitment and inspiration is translated into meaningful progress.
